purpose: Long-term vegetation trend across Landsat epochs, absolute and relative to the city median

parameters.relative: NDVI − land-cell median NDVI of the same epoch

interpretation_notes: The absolute trend contains epoch-wide shifts (TM→OLI sensor change, antecedent rainfall, acquisition dates) common to all cells; the relative trend isolates cells that greened or browned compared with Karachi as a whole. Headline shares use the relative trend.
limitations: With ≤ 5 epochs, Kendall's τ has little power: p < 0.05 needs a near-monotonic series.
Epoch composites differ in scene count and weather.
